ios.desc:
Keep your favorite recipes close, your shopping list ready, and your next cooking step in view. Sous brings recipe collecting, planning and cooking into one calm workspace.

ROOM TO COOK
On an unfolded iPhone Duo, keep ingredients and instructions side by side. Follow the highlighted step, adjust servings and run multiple timers. The layout adapts when you fold or rotate your phone.

COLLECT YOUR RECIPES
Import supported recipe pages, pasted text and selected photos with AI. Save a bookmark when a page cannot be imported, or add a recipe manually. Organize your collection with folders, favorites and tags.

PLAN YOUR SHOP
Combine ingredients from selected recipes, add your own shopping items and check them off as you go. Optional AI grouping organizes ingredients by grocery aisle. Share a recipe or shopping list with a link after reviewing what will be published.

MAKE IT YOURS
Scale ingredient quantities proportionally, switch between metric, imperial and original measurements, and keep personal notes and photos with your recipes. Ask Sous for recipe-specific cooking help. Review AI suggestions, especially quantities, allergens and cooking guidance.

YOUR CHOICES, CLEARLY EXPLAINED
AI features ask permission before sending your selected content through Cloudflare to Google Gemini. Web recipe discovery uses Google Search and includes source links. You can use saved recipes, manual editing and timers without AI. Usage analytics are enabled by default and can be turned off in Settings.

Your recipe collection can sync through your private iCloud account when available.

Try Sous with five recipes. Sous Pro removes the recipe-library limit. AI features require internet access and are subject to service allowances.

Privacy Policy: https://sous-privacy-policy.sous-api.workers.dev/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: Sous – App that imports recipes from URLs, and cookbook photos using AI

quotes.text:
I built Sous because I was tired of:

1. Scrolling through 2000-word life stories to find a recipe
2. Trying to copy recipes from Instagram captions
3. Squinting at my phone with messy hands while cooking

The app uses Google Gemini to parse recipes from any URL (handles messy blog formats), 
photos of cookbooks/handwritten notes, and even TikTok/Instagram/YouTube videos.

How it works:
- AI extracts structured ingredients and steps, pre-converts all measurements to both metric and imperial
- Live Activities show timers on your Lock Screen
- Siri control for hands-free cooking ("Hey Siri, start my pasta timer")
- AI chat assistant that knows your recipe context for substitutions and troubleshooting

I'd love feedback, especially on the parsing accuracy and cooking experience.

Learn more: https://getsousapp.com/

Try it out here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sous-smart-recipe-companion/id6756943039
